name: fyrst/shopware-cd
description: fyrst.dev Shopware continuous-deploy overlay. Thin Packagist package: Symfony Flex copies dual CI, Compose, and VPS deploy files after shopware-cli project create. Not a Shopware installation.

suggest.shopware/docker: Official multi-stage Dockerfile via Symfony Flex (usually docker/Dockerfile). Prefer that file; this recipe's root Dockerfile is a fallback.
suggest.shopware/deployment-helper: Deploy-time install/update. Require it in the shop in the same composer require as this package.
